title: Query Basics
description: Learn the fundamentals of React Query for server state management.
longDescription: This module introduces React Query's core concepts: what server state is, how React Query differs from client state libraries, and how to set up QueryClientProvider. You will write your first useQuery, understand query keys, and see how caching works out of the box.
whatYouLearn: Understand what React Query is and why it exists
Create and configure a QueryClient instance
Write your first useQuery with loading and error states
Use query keys to identify and organize cached data
